slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory reports that Ghana's Cabinet has officially approved the National AI Strategy, to be launched by the President in the coming weeks; no approval date is given, so the date is the bimonthly update's January-February 2026 period, whose publication date is 2026-06-23.
